GmailDock v0.2.3

- Opening the shortcut now focuses the running app instead of creating another tray icon.
- Start at login can be changed in Settings and is on by default.
- Available updates show their release notes in a centered dialog with an Update now button.
- Settings now has an About section with the developer and repository links.
- Removed the taskbar unread count badge.
- Google account sign-in popups can open inside GmailDock when Gmail requests a new window.

Windows is the currently tested platform. macOS and Linux users are invited to test and report issues.
